# Contributing

Open an issue to discuss a change before you make it.

1. Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): setup from a fresh clone, and how to verify a change
   against the real UI. [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) lists the architecture decisions that must
   not be reversed.
2. Run `pnpm verify` before you push. It is the same gate CI runs.

Everyone taking part follows the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), which also has the
contact address for reporting a problem.
